messages.subject: fortify.lm + geom_smooth () error
parts:
Problem is related to geom_smooth().  I can not use geom_smooth (method="lm", formula= X1~X2) " 
or any other "formula" option, so fortify with ggplot2 use "loess" function instead of "lm" automatically.

Data Set: 

# Names of Variables
> names(cdata)                         
[1] "X1" "X2" "X3" "X4"

# Dimension of Data Set
> dim(cdata)
[1] 522   4

Problem 1: 

qplot(X2, .stdresid, data = fortify(mod, cdata))+geom_smooth()

Error:

geom_smooth: method="auto" and size of largest group is <1000, so using loess. Use 'method = x' to change the smoothing method.


Problem 2:

 qplot(X1,X2,datam=cmodel, xlab="Market",ylab="Sector_i")+stat_smooth(method="lm")+geom_smooth(method="lm",formula=X1~X2)

Error in data.frame(x = xseq, fit, se = pred$se) : 
  arguments imply differing number of rows: 80, 522
In addition: Warning message:
'newdata' had 80 rows but variable(s) found have 522 rows 

# I do not know why "new data" length is 80.


How to fix it for linear model.

Regards
Serdar

messages.subject: Re: fortify.lm + geom_smooth () error

On Tue, Dec 4, 2012 at 9:14 AM, Serdar Neslihanoglu <snes...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Problem is related to geom_smooth(). I can not use geom_smooth
> (method="lm", formula= X1~X2) "
> or any other "formula" option, so fortify with ggplot2 use "loess" function
> instead of "lm" automatically.
>
> Data Set:
>
> # Names of Variables
>> names(cdata)
> [1] "X1" "X2" "X3" "X4"
>
> # Dimension of Data Set
>> dim(cdata)
> [1] 522 4
>
> Problem 1:
>
> qplot(X2, .stdresid, data = fortify(mod, cdata))+geom_smooth()
>
> Error:
>
> geom_smooth: method="auto" and size of largest group is <1000, so using

> loess. Use 'method = x' to change the smoothing method.\

The default smoothing method in geom_smooth() is loess.

The formula is unnecessary - method = lm is sufficient. Had the
formula been necessary, you would need to have used formula = y ~ x.
ggplot2 will map y to X1 and x to X2 internally.

Dennis
